{{Quote|Come, Dooku&mdash;we are at the ''heart'' of Mother Talzin's power now...and you are about to answer for your master's crimes against the Nightsisters.|Brother Viscus, to Count Dooku|<ref name="SoD4" />}}
[[Brother/Legends|Brother]] '''Viscus''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] who headed the [[Nightbrother village/Legends|Nightbrother village]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Biography==

===Life on Dathomir===
By the times of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref> Brother<ref name="SWArchive-The Clone Wars Episode Guide: Monster">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode313.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster}}</ref> Viscus headed<ref name="Clone Card: Brother Viscus" /> a [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]]' [[Nightbrother village/Legends|village]] in an isolated region of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Res">"[[Restraint]]" — ''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref>[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 48|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 48]] {{C|20 BBY 9-12: Ventress and the Nightsisters}} dates the events of "[[Monster]]" to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Viscus was present when [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] arrived to acquire an adept servant for a plot to gain revenge on her ex-Master Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Viscus brought forward his tribal heads for Ventress's inspection, including [[Feral/Legends|Feral]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Both brothers were among the six clan leaders who were deemed fit as candidates for the [[Selection/Legends|Selection]]. Eventually Viscus supervised the challenges, clapping his hands together from atop a cliff to start each of the challenges. He was later present when [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] was taken away from the [[Nightbrother village/Legends|village]] in Ventress' [[Nightsister speeder/Legends|speeder]] to became a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]].<ref name=":0" />[[File:AnakinViscus-WOTM.png|thumb|left|250x250px|Anakin holds Viscus' attention]]Viscus' village later received more unexpected visitors, in the form of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who were looking for information about Savage Opress. When the duo arrived at the village, Viscus directed his fellow Nightbrothers to attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. As the battle progressed, Skywalker leaped to the roof where Viscus stood, and after a brief scuffle, grabbed him and held his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to the helpless [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother's]] throat. Viscus ordered his men to stop fighting, and reluctantly told Kenobi and Skywalker to seek out [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] for the information they sought. As Skywalker released Viscus and departed the village with Kenobi, Viscus prevented his men from further attacking the Jedi, allowing them to leave in peace.<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

===Fighting for Darth Maul===
Later that year,<ref name="SoD Date">{{FactFile2014|44|20 BBY 47-50|Maul on Mandalore}} dates the events of {{TCW|The Lawless}} to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. Since [[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir|''Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir'']] takes place directly after, it must also take place in 20 BBY.</ref> Viscus and a team of Nightbrothers were later sent to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] by Mother Talzin to assist [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], who were preparing a trap to capture [[Count/Legends]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Nightbrothers arrived just as the [[Battle on Ord Mantell/Legends|battle]] began. Viscus and the Nightbrothers fought against Dooku himself. Many were killed by Dooku and Viscus himself was badly injured during the battle, but saved from death due to the intervention of Maul's allies, who were successful in capturing the [[Sith Lord]].<ref name="Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 2]]</ref>

In the aftermath of the battle, Brother Viscus returned to Dathomir where he greeted Maul, who returned home to the Nightbrothers' village with the captive Count Dooku and brought them to the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] of Mother Talzin's power. As Talzin drained Dooku's life force, Viscus left with the remaining Nightbrothers to prepare her bedchambers, fearing that the process could probably weaken her.<ref name="SoD4">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]]</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
In combat Viscus would often attack with the "Rain of Blows", a [[K'thri]] [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] attack.<ref name="TCW H2H" />
